body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Hi-im International, Korean retailer of Urbantool, presented ''grooveRider'' a T-shirt with buttons for iPod during KES 2006. According to the company, you can take control of iPod using the buttons on the clothes. It also has a pocket for iPod. Of course, you can wash it without any problem.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
